  - text: Result, conclusion and limitation
  - textbox "Water-cycle conclusion": The three inventories total 100 g in every trial. Warm and equal-temperature lids collected no water. At 300 s, faster return left 0.009270 g on the lid versus 0.049234 g with slower return. The chosen maintained-temperature and first-order transfer model is not a physical droplet-detachment or heat-flow experiment.
  - paragraph: Fixed reference headspace/area, maintained temperatures, initially dry air, chosen transfer/drain laws and reference liquid density1g/cm³. No sensible-heat field, CFD, actual droplet nucleation/coalescence or transit inventory is solved.16 hemispherical model sites encode shared lid storage, not literal counts or detachment. Pool-level changes are intentionally tiny at this scale. Arrows show phase/return fluxes, not visible vapour or drop trajectories. The latest60 observations remain in this browser.
